name: quest-script-end-notify
summary: Tell the client when a quest script reaches END, so a client that does not close its own dialog (2026) closes it on the LAST page only - no close/reopen between pages.
status: PROVEN ON THE WIRE 2026-09-17 with a scripted client (Fiesta2026on2016 tools/shim_client_test.py --click-mob --ack-pages). Skillmaster Mora, one-page DOING script: stock sends the page and then nothing; patched sends the page, takes the ack, and sends 0x4401 {20135, command 1}. Healer Ellen, nine-page START script: pages 110401 -> 110402 -> 110403 with NO END between them. No crash file. NOT yet seen through a real 2026 client - that it closes the window on this packet is read from its handler, not observed.
why: THE ZONE ALREADY HAS THE SEND AND BOTH CLIENTS ALREADY HAVE THE HANDLER; one early exit keeps them apart.
CQuestZone::QuestNext (0x5BDEF0) walks a quest script token by token. Its switch has a case for QSC_END
(command 1, jump table 0x5BF020 slot 0 -> 0x5BE0D9) that calls Send_NC_QUEST_SCRIPT_CMD_REQ - a 0x4401
carrying command 1. On the client, On_NC_QUEST_SCRIPT_CMD_REQ case 1 is CloseWin(NpcDialogWin), in the
2016 build (0x4BAB1A) and the 2026 one (Fiesta.exe 0x5B4645) alike.
That case is dead code. The loop tests for END before it ever reaches the switch:
005BDFD1  call ParserNext
005BDFDC  cmp  dword [esi+0x7D0], 1        ; token type == QSC_END ?
005BDFE3  je   0x5BE1F8                    ; -> QuestClose + sp_EndOfTrade, nothing sent
and again at the bottom of each pass (0x5BE1EB). So no capture of a 2016 server has ever shown a 0x4401
with command 1, and the live bridge log agrees (29 x command 02, 1 x 06, none of 01).
The 2016 client never noticed: its dialog closes ITSELF on every button click and the next SAY reopens it.
The 2026 client does not - it holds the window open until it is told (NpcDialogWin::DirectMessage gates the
self-close on a flag only 0x442E sets; see client-2026-npc-dialog-self-close). Against a 2016 zone that
leaves the last page of every script stuck open. Both existing answers - that client recipe, and
Bridge2026 sending 0x442E after every page ack - close the window on EVERY click, which flickers between
pages. Only the server knows which page is the last one, and this is the server saying so.
THE PATCH: the `call QuestClose` at the END exit (0x5BE1FA) goes through a cave.
cave:  cmp   dword [esi+0x7D0], 1      ; END itself, not EOF (0x23) or a parse stop (0)
jne   close
mov   eax, [ebx+0x8FC]          ; the token ParserNext just returned
test  eax, eax
jz    close
movzx edx, word [ebx+0x906]     ; the running quest - QuestClose is about to clear it
push  eax
push  edx
mov   ecx, ebx
call  Send_NC_QUEST_SCRIPT_CMD_REQ   ; __thiscall(questId, STRUCT_QSC*), ret 8
close: mov   ecx, ebx
jmp   QuestClose                ; tail call: returns to 0x5BE1FF as the original did
Same argument order as the dead case at 0x5BE0D9. QuestClose takes no stack argument, so reaching it by
jmp from a cave that was itself `call`ed leaves the stack exactly as the original call did - the
double-return-address trap that crashed the first npc-click-quest-fallthrough build does not arise. esi is
the parser (ebx+0xB8) on all three ways into 0x5BE1F8, and ebx / esi / edi survive the send.
A 2016 client gets a CloseWin for a window it has already closed. Harmless.
WITH THIS IN, Bridge2026 should stop sending 0x442E per ack (BRIDGE2026_CLOSE_DIALOG=0 / run-bridge
-NoDialogClose): the relayed 0x4401{END} closes the 2026 dialog by the client's own END case.

new_section.name: .qend
new_section.note: Executable. Must be materialised: code cannot live in a zero-fill BSS tail.

code.why: send 0x4401{QSC_END} before QuestClose when the script reached END

edits.why: QuestNext END exit: call the cave instead of QuestClose directly
